manufacturer_handling_constraints: Do not press or insert into tight gaps without manufacturer consultation; avoid clamp/press-fit architecture.
Keep hot soldering parts above150C away from film.
Bend only once90degrees, at least7mm from sensor head; fixation at least3mm from head.
proposed_assembly: Seller preconnects sensor to PCB and prepares insulated joints/strain relief and a peelable attachment patch. Buyer plugs battery and places sensor using locating feature; no soldering, lead cutting or connector replacement. Attachment chemistry and exact process unselected.
potential_benefit: Sensor follows battery surface; eliminates need for a thick pad bridging board-to-battery gap.
limits: No circuit or BOM substitution performed.
B3380 existing sensor and B3435 candidate are not interchangeable without threshold/error review.
Beta model is only approximate, especially below25C; use manufacturer R-T tolerance and comparator errors before qualification.
5s air time constant is not installed battery sensing lag.
Tape adhesion to pouch, removability, insulation, lead routing, strain relief and misplaced/detached-sensor fault behavior remain unresolved.
Full25mm strip and solder joints must be fitted in3D; dimensions alone do not prove assembly fit.
